notes: Three fixes from 3.3.0's new features. Backtrack now returns to your real starting location instead of the previous spoofed spot: after stopping a spoof and starting a new one, the origin was captured from a stale coordinate, so “Back to start” sent you to the last fake place rather than where you actually were. Places and Settings stay reachable while spoofing: the live control card was covering the search orb, leaving no way into Places (or Settings, reached from it), so a search orb now sits in the right-edge rail whenever the big orb is hidden. And the Backtrack quick action no longer overflows its tile — it reads “Backtrack”, with the full destination name kept on the map's wide button.
